author: /root/construct_integer_witnesses
claim: Actual compact-step recurrence and original prefix witnesses with preselected guard margins, plus an explicit P-centered scalar-good region for one-modulus progressions.

obligations.name: Original carrier and topology
obligations.required_input: Actual two-real-embedding arithmetic points with inherited topology.
obligations.justification: No independent real coordinates, transported topology, or full-product density is substituted.

obligations.name: Compact recurrence source
obligations.required_input: A compact topological group and a point in the closed integer orbit of the actual step.
obligations.constructed_input: Pair is compact and topological; Compatible specifies exactly the required translate.
obligations.justification: The cluster-point theorem applies to the same step; its neighborhood characterization gives t > B.

obligations.name: Index-set coverage
obligations.required_input: All four fixed nonzero integer labels simultaneously.
obligations.constructed_input: The region intersects all j : Fin 4, and the same t satisfies each inequality.
obligations.justification: Finite open intersection and positivity at the identity, or negativity at P, establish one usable region.

obligations.name: Transition and progression map
obligations.required_input: The returned real point must equal the original arithmetic h = r + k t point.
obligations.constructed_input: progression_point proves pairOrbit r + t times (k generator) equals pairOrbit (r+k*t).
obligations.justification: Integer/natural casts, multiplication order and the translate are explicit; h-1 is retained downstream.

obligations.name: Quantifier order and uniform margins
obligations.required_input: Guard bounds must be chosen before later progression moduli.
obligations.constructed_input: Both margin functions depend only on labels and their fixed identity/P evaluation.
obligations.justification: k and r occur only after margin definitions; no modulus-dependent lower bound is introduced.

obligations.name: Component and CRT access
obligations.required_input: Final mixed residues must meet the component containing a good scalar region.
obligations.constructed_input: Compatibility with zero or P is explicit. Zero modulo k and one modulo k are proved separately.
obligations.justification: General CRT compatibility, finite component annihilation and identity-component access are not proved and are not inferred from these special classes.

obligations.name: Scalar object and normalization
obligations.required_input: A norm bound on the same coherent u_H used by the literal source.
obligations.constructed_input: chartU(1)=(8+14 sqrt(2))/41, norm=-8/41; scalarNorm_orbit identifies real product with rational normCoefficient.
obligations.justification: The P-centered region gives |Norm u_H|>1/100 on the same selected h. It is not asserted to lie in G^0 or avoid inherited poles.

obligations.name: Literal consumer identity
obligations.required_input: The exact original assignment, input and all four root signs must consume the same arithmetic point.
obligations.constructed_input: witness q labels h; first51 source constraints; witness input equality; emitted_root_fixed for each j.
obligations.justification: guards_iff converts the actual rational nonzeros, then witness_rows and fixed-root theorem use these exact charts.

obligations.name: Downstream scope and validation
obligations.required_input: No claim of full sourceArithmetic without all remaining inputs.
obligations.constructed_input: Only first51 rows and selected guard/scalar bounds; 237 later rows and full theorem remain open.
obligations.justification: No accepted source or manuscript was changed; all predecessor copies are byte-bound and hosted compilation is pending.
